programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Championship game
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Henry Danger

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Leek ja monstermasinad
programme.desc: Leek ja monstermasinad on arvutiga animeeritud interaktiivne sari, mille peaosas on Leek, maailma kõige imelisem Monstermasin, tema juht kaheksa-aastane poiss nimega AJ ning nende seiklused Veosilla linnas. Veosilla linnas ei sära ükski täht eredamalt kui Leek. Ta on võidusõidurajal tšempion ning tänavatel kangelane. Kus on pahandust, seal pöördutakse tema poole, sest kõik teavad, et Leek suudab teha asju, mida teised autod ei suuda. Ta on kiireim monstermasin terves linnas: tal on Leegikiirus. Leek suudab seljatada kõik raskused kasutades oma teaduslikke teadmisi. Kui olukord kipub kitsaks, siis suudab ta muunduda ükskõik missuguseks masinaks ning leida lahenduse parasjagu käesolevale probleemile.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbabright katab maja maagilise tootega, et veelekkeid ei tekiks. Järgmisel päeval tõmbub maja kokku nagu õhupall. Lind ehitab pesa Barbazoo kõhule. Barbazoo tahab muutuda suureks puuks, et loomadele kodu pakkuda. See muutub keeruliseks.

programme.title: Будущее сегодня
programme.desc: Как изменится мир в ближайшие десятилетия? Какие открытия больше всего повлияют на нашу жизнь? Документальный научно-популярный сериал RTД "Будущее сегодня" - это рассказ о новых технологиях, которые должны сделать существование человека более комфортным, здоровым и долгим. Ведущие проекта попробуют заглянуть в будущее и представить, что нас ждёт.

programme.title: Свидетели Путина
programme.desc: События фильма начинаются 31 декабря 1999 года, когда россиянам представили их нового президента. Фильм основан на уникальных и строго документальных свидетельствах истинных причин и последствий операции "преемник", в результате которой россия оказалась с президентом, который правит страной до сих пор. Главными героями фильма являются Михаил Горбачев, Борис Ельцин, Владимир Путин и русский народ, который как всегда безмолвствует.

programme.title: Человек имеет право
programme.desc: В программе Марьяны Торочешниковой юристы, правозащитники, гражданские активисты и обычные граждане подводят главные итоги недели.

programme.title: Реальная история
programme.desc: Масштабный просветительский проект направлен на деконструкцию исторических мифов, опровержение многолетних манипуляций и возвращение истинного понимания прошлого. В центре внимания — ключевые этапы создания государства, фигуры выдающихся лидеров и малоизвестные факты, которые десятилетиями замалчивались или искажались. Благодаря привлечению ведущих ученых, работе с уникальными архивными документами и динамической визуальной подаче проект превращает сложные исторические процессы в понятный и увлекательный контент. Это интеллектуальное путешествие, которое помогает осознать продолжительность борьбы за независимость и найти подлинные смыслы национальной идентичности в контексте современности.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.title: Грани времени
programme.desc: Еженедельная итоговая программа с Мумином Шакировым.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Программа "Утро" каждый будний день открывает информационную линейку телеканала "Настоящее Время". "Утро" выходит в прямом эфире из киевской студии и рассказывает зрителям о том, что им надо знать в самом начале дня. Главные новости, основные события наступающего дня, самые важные темы для обсуждения - в утренних эфирах каждый день.

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Документальный проект рассказывает о разных американских штатах и городах через истории их жителей, культуру и кухню. Авторы приглашают зрителей за кулисы известных туристских центров и знакомят их с людьми, которые представляют собой коллективный портрет американского общества и демонстрируют лучшие качества американского характера: целеустремленность, инициативность, самодостаточность. Особое внимание в каждом эпизоде будет уделяться предпринимателям, сильным и независимым женщинам, успешным эмигрантам и представителям меньшинств.

programme.title: Репортер
programme.desc: Необычные истории из повседневной жизни

programme.desc: Как изменится мир в ближайшие десятилетия? Какие открытия больше всего повлияют на нашу жизнь? programme.title: Главные фигуры
programme.desc: Президент Владимир Путин так давно находится у власти, что многие просто не замечают никого рядом. А ведь именно свита играет короля. Окружение Путина несёт не меньшую ответственность за политический режим внутри страны и многолетнюю военную агрессию. Кто же они, откуда взялись и какие интересы преследуют? О людях вокруг Путина в совместном проекте Настоящего Времени и The Insider.

programme.title: Искусство в деталях
programme.desc: Передача "Искусство в деталях" глубоко исследует международную креативную сцену, раскрывая новые идеи и объясняя культурные феномены, которые формируют нашу историю, настоящее и будущее. Кто такие современные художники? Какие произведения стали их визитной карточкой? Какое влияние они оказывают на общество? И где можно познакомиться с их яркими проектами?

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: Информационная программа "Азия" знакомит с новостями центральноазиатского региона – Казахстана, Кыргызстана, Таджикистана, Туркменистана и Узбекистана. Это эксклюзивные репортажи и расследования, интервью с независимыми журналистами и гражданскими активистами, политиками и правозащитниками. Материалы наших корреспондентов часто являются альтернативой официальным сообщениям.

programme.title: Нью-Йорк New York
programme.desc: Нью-Йорк, New York - воскресный видеожурнал о городе большого яблока и его обитателях. Что надо увидеть, узнать, съесть, надеть и... понять о Нью-Йорке. Ведущие Елена Мещерякова и Евгений Маслов покажут вам места, ставшие символами города, и объяснят, почему они до сих пор сохраняют свою важность. Мы прогуляемся по Центральному парку и Таймс-сквер, зайдем на Центральный вокзал и поднимемся на Эмпайр-стейт-билдинг. Вы познакомитесь с личными историями ньюйоркцев, которым есть что рассказать. А еще вам будет интересно узнать о странных нью-йоркских привычках, будь то плавание в ледяной воде или игра на бочках.

programme.title: Свидетели Путина
programme.desc: События фильма начинаются 31 декабря 1999 года, когда россиянам представили их нового президента. programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа.

programme.title: Опасное соседство
programme.desc: Документальный цикл о том, как живут и как чувствуют себя жители независимых государств, соседствующих с РФ, в связи с агрессией России в отношении Украины. Опасаются ли вторжения или гибридного нарушения суверенитета их страны со стороны России? Или, возможно, считают себя частью "русского мира"? С какими проблемами сталкиваются в связи с влиянием на их страну России? Нравится ли им такое соседство и считают ли они его опасным?

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Aвторский проект Вадима Кондакова. Это получасовые документальные истории о местах и людях, о которых мало кто знает. И которые станут для зрителя настоящим открытием. Автор побывал в самой самой западной точке страны, в Калининграде, где люди, без света и воды, живут в казематах заброшенного немецкого форта XIX века. И на далеких Курильских островах, в городе-призраке, про жителей которых почему-то забыли на материке. Кроме того, "Неизвестная Россия" расскажет о том, что за таинственный сигнал из космоса поймали в астрофизической обсерватории Нижнего Архыза. И можно ли стать дорожным полицейским, если ты родился в городе дальнобойщиков. В общем, "Неизвестная Россия" показывает страну такой, какой ее не знают даже сами россияне.

programme.title: #вУкраине
programme.desc: Многие годы она страдала из-за "родственника за границей" - её старшая сестра, которая была вместе с ней в плену, после освобождения вышла замуж за француза и домой не вернулась. Всю жизнь в Советском Союзе Валентина Артёмовна расплачивалась за то, в чем её вины не было. А когда началось полномасштабное вторжение в Украину, дети и внуки её сестры организовали целую спасательную операцию, чтобы вывезти из-под ракетных обстрелов любимую двоюродную бабушку. Два года она провела во Франции, но её единственным желанием было вернутся на родину и подышать украинским воздухом.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Европейские ценности
programme.desc: На канале "Настоящее время" мы тщательно изучили все основополагающие ценности Европейского союза и поставили перед собой задачу узнать, как эти ценности реализуются в повседневной жизни обычных европейцев. Разрушая укоренившиеся стереотипы, мы покажем основополагающие гуманистические ценности европейских стран. Мы расскажем о том, что представляют собой министерство воды, права на природу, уважение к человеческому достоинству, какова должна быть тюрьма, и что может сделать мэр небольшого города, чтобы сохранить его историю. Все это вы узнаете в нашей программе "Европейские ценности".

programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа.

programme.title: Опасное соседство
programme.desc: Документальный цикл о том, как живут и как чувствуют себя жители независимых государств, соседствующих с РФ, в связи с агрессией России в отношении Украины. Опасаются ли вторжения или гибридного нарушения суверенитета их страны со стороны России? Или, возможно, считают себя частью "русского мира"? С какими проблемами сталкиваются в связи с влиянием на их страну России? Нравится ли им такое соседство и считают ли они его опасным?

programme.title: Синдром Гамлета
programme.desc: Подобно Гамлету, Ярослав, Екатерина, Родион, Оксана и Роман сталкиваются с серьезными экзистенциальными дилеммами. "Жить или не жить" - это переосмысленная Ярославом фраза "быть или не быть", родившаяся в результате его размышлений о своем физическом, на волосок от смерти, участии в боях на Донбассе в 2014 году. Катерина и Роман тоже были участниками этой войны, в то время как Оксана и Родион ведут борьбу в консервативном и нетерпимом обществе, будучи представителями движения феминисток и ЛГБТК-сообщества. Режиссеры: Эльвира Нивейра, Петр Росоловский. Польша, Германия, 2022

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Aвторский проект Вадима Кондакова. Это получасовые документальные истории о местах и людях, о которых мало кто знает. И которые станут для зрителя настоящим открытием. Автор побывал в самой самой западной точке страны, в Калининграде, где люди, без света и воды, живут в казематах заброшенного немецкого форта XIX века. И на далеких Курильских островах, в городе-призраке, про жителей которых почему-то забыли на материке. Кроме того, "Неизвестная Россия" расскажет о том, что за таинственный сигнал из космоса поймали в астрофизической обсерватории Нижнего Архыза. И можно ли стать дорожным полицейским, если ты родился в городе дальнобойщиков. В общем, "Неизвестная Россия" показывает страну такой, какой ее не знают даже сами россияне.

programme.title: #вУкраине
programme.desc: Многие годы она страдала из-за "родственника за границей" - её старшая сестра, которая была вместе с ней в плену, после освобождения вышла замуж за француза и домой не вернулась. Всю жизнь в Советском Союзе Валентина Артёмовна расплачивалась за то, в чем её вины не было. А когда началось полномасштабное вторжение в Украину, дети и внуки её сестры организовали целую спасательную операцию, чтобы вывезти из-под ракетных обстрелов любимую двоюродную бабушку. Два года она провела во Франции, но её единственным желанием было вернутся на родину и подышать украинским воздухом.

programme.title: Азия

Это эксклюзивные репортажи и расследования, интервью с независимыми журналистами и гражданскими активистами, политиками и правозащитниками. Материалы наших корреспондентов часто являются альтернативой официальным сообщениям.

programme.title: Нью-Йорк New York
programme.desc: Нью-Йорк, New York - воскресный видеожурнал о городе большого яблока и его обитателях. Что надо увидеть, узнать, съесть, надеть и... понять о Нью-Йорке. Ведущие Елена Мещерякова и Евгений Маслов покажут вам места, ставшие символами города, и объяснят, почему они до сих пор сохраняют свою важность. Мы прогуляемся по Центральному парку и Таймс-сквер, зайдем на Центральный вокзал и поднимемся на Эмпайр-стейт-билдинг. Вы познакомитесь с личными историями ньюйоркцев, которым есть что рассказать. А еще вам будет интересно узнать о странных нью-йоркских привычках, будь то плавание в ледяной воде или игра на бочках.

programme.title: Jalgpall: Hispaania LaLiga. Barcelona - Real Madrid
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Inglismaa esiliiga. Southampton vs Middlesbrough
programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Gainsbourg: A Heroic Life
programme.desc: Lucien Ginsburg, a rebellious French Jewish boy with a grotesque imagination, hates playing the piano like his father, a bar professional, and manages to be admitted to Montmartre Academy as a painter, where he befriends an SS officer who helps him survive the occupation. After the war, he chooses to become a performing artist and adopts the stage name Serge Gainsbourg. His unorthodox songs bring him success, even his parents's approval, and lots of lovers, yet his marriages are all utter failures.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Swallows and Amazons
programme.desc: Four children dream of escaping the tedium of a summer holiday with their mother. When finally given permission to camp on their own on an island in the middle of a vast lake in the Lake District, they are overjoyed. But when they get there they discover they may not be alone. The battle for ownership of a lonely island teaches them the skills of survival, the value of friendship and the importance of holding your nerve. Based on the novel by Arthur Ransome.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: The Chef's Wife
programme.desc: The wife of a successful chef feels unfulfilled in her rôle as dining-room hostess and consults career counselor, who is herself dissatisfied by her useful but mundane place in the scheme of things. Without meaning to, the two women find their lives growing tangled together, with ever more complex tragicomic consequences.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: For thirty years, three French-Algerian sisters have been hoping to find their brother who was abducted by their father, and hidden in newly decolonized Algeria. Their relationship is shaken when the eldest decides to write a play based on the traumatizing events of their childhood and they learn that their father is dying and decide to go to Algeria to seize their last opportunity to have him reveal where their brother is.

programme.title: Thunderpants
programme.desc: An 11-year-old boy's amazing ability to break wind leads him first to fame and then to death row before it helps him to fulfil his ambition of becoming an astronaut.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: Biopic chronicling the three-month period in 1965 which saw Dr Martin Luther King Jr lead a march from Selma to Montgomery. Despite the passing of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 which outlawed segregation, many black people still found they were being denied fundamental rights. In the face of extreme opposition from many who were determined to undermine their efforts, King and his fellow campaigners endured damaging smears and shocking physical attacks on the path to securing equal voting rights.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: Drama. French drama, produced in 2010. While in Tuscany to promote his latest book, a middle-aged British writer meets a French gallery owner woman who is also a fan of his books and they set off on a tour of Tuscany.

programme.title: Hunting and Gathering
programme.desc: The film opens showing the day-to-day life of an elderly lady named Paulette. Paulette lives alone, dedicated to her animals, in particular her cats, and her garden. Her worst fear is of dying far from her home and garden. However, when she takes a fall she is sent to hospital who then advise that she recovers in a nursing-home, much to her dismay.

programme.title: Big Nothing
programme.desc: Jean-Baptiste Andrea's dark comedy stars Simon Pegg and David Schwimmer as Gus and Charlie, two workers at a call centre that deals with software problems, who come up with a plan to blackmail pillars of society who are downloading porn. Unfortunately, their plans soon go awry and the body count rises. As Charlie's policewoman wife Penelope (Natascha McElhone) gets too close to the truth, FBI agent Hymes (Jon Polito) closes in from another angle and Gus's ex-girlfriend Josie (Alice Eve) also finds herself involved.

programme.title: Sorry Angel
programme.desc: 1993. Jacques (Pierre Deladonchamps) is a 39-year-old gay author living and working in Paris. He is a part-time, albeit inattentive, father to his young son Loulou, who stays with him every other night. Loulou is accustomed to his father's bouts of self-indulgent melancholy as well as his manic appreciation for the arts and his string of young lovers. At the same time, Jacques is in the process of coming to terms with his health's steady decline due to AIDS, which is simultaneously and severely affecting his ex-lover Marco. When Marco is rejected by his lover Thierry and comes to stay with Jacques, the two discuss again their intentions to commit suicide before they can be claimed by the disease. Jacques lives on the floor below his good friend Mathieu (Denis Podalydès), an older gay man and newspaper editor who regular caters to Jacques' flamboyant episodes.

programme.title: Last Orders
programme.desc: On a cold winter day, Bear puts on his nightcap and decides to take a nice winter's nap. However, it would seem that others in the Big Blue House have other plans for Bear. Ojo comes to Bear in alarm --- concerned about the sudden disappearance of her duck friends from the Otter Pond. Bear makes her a cup of cocoa and tells her about migration. Treelo takes Bear outside, telling him there's feathers falling from the sky. Bear introduces him to the delights of snow. Bear finally settles down for the nap, but is woken up by Pip and Pop. They take him outside, where all the kids have a special surprise for him. Tutter's been trying to take a nap too, but with all the noise, he finds himself just as awake as Bear. In the Shadow segment, Shadow tries to help Bear get to sleep. She sings "Rockabye Baby." Songs In the Middle of Winter Notes In this episode, Ojo talks about her duck friends out at the Otter Pond. Duck characters were first seen on the program in the third season, with the introduction of Harry and his Mom in "Lost and Found."

programme.title: Synecdoche, New York
programme.desc: Theater director Caden Cotard is mounting a new play. Fresh off of a successful production of Death of a Salesman, he has traded in the suburban blue-hairs and regional theater of Schenectady for the cultured audiences and bright footlights of Broadway. Armed with a MacArthur grant and determined to create a piece of brutal realism and honesty, something into which he can put his whole self, he gathers an ensemble cast into a warehouse in Manhattan's theater district. He directs them in a celebration of the mundane, instructing each to live out their constructed lives in a small mock-up of the city outside. As the city inside the warehouse grows, Caden's own life veers wildly off the tracks. The shadow of his ex-wife Adele, a celebrated painter who left him years ago for Germany's art scene, sneers at him from every corner. Somewhere in Berlin, his daughter Olive is growing up under the questionable guidance of Adele's friend, Maria. He's helplessly driving his marriage to actress ...

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined.

programme.title: Animal Cribs
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: Project Grizzly
programme.desc: The Project Grizzly series follows the trials and tribulations of world renowned bear trainer Jeff Watson as he battles against time to teach his rescued grizzlies the skills and tricks needed for them to survive back in the wild where they truly belong. The domesticated grizzlies Bob and Screech learn to live outside the cage, to fish, to hunt and to live in the wild. Raised by him since cubs, Jeff's decision is not only emotionally charged but emotive in the message it gives of a 'father's' love to do the best for his young.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

The experienced tree climbers do their best to rescue all of the cats they find out about whether a call comes in at day or night. With sometimes unfavourable weather, weak branches and bees nests to overcome the pair have to overcome obstacles and then have to avoid scaring the cats away as they approach.

programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive
programme.desc: Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

programme.title: Rugged Justice
programme.desc: Animal Planet's Rugged Justice follows the officers from Washington State's Department of Fish and Wildlife Law Enforcement as they guard the vast borders. It is an elite unit that protect people and wildlife, patrolling coastal areas, mountainous terrains and rugged roads of rainforests. Every day brings a new challenge, dispatchers receive around 25.000 calls annually, every of which requires prompt reaction.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon
programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: The Holzer Files
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation.

Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. Andrew is game for anything and knows the most interesting food is found closest to the source. So whether he's chasing down large water rodents in the Louisiana bayou, fishing for piranha in the Amazon or flushing out cave bats in Malaysia, you can be sure the guy with the iron stomach will dish up the unimaginable.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

programme.title: Murder In the Heartland
programme.desc: A tip comes in from an unexpected Willard, Missouri resident that leads to the final resting ground of missing newlyweds Russell 'Rusty' Porter, age 34, and Rebecca 'Becky' Porter, age 46. The couple was described as being very much in love and had been married for about a year. The Porters disappeared in April 2011. Their skeletal remains were found in remote Taney County in late July 2011. The coroner said each died of gunshot wounds to the head. In the end, their deaths were a murder-for-hire. Rusty's uncle, Robert Campbell, was the mastermind. Campbell hired his brother-in-law, Tony Friend, to carry out the murder for $100K. The hired hitman, Tony Friend, then enlisted the assistance of his wife Wendy Dawn Friend, his son Phillip and his cousin Dusty Hicks. All five perpetrators were convicted, found guilty and sentenced to varying amounts of time in jail.

programme.title: Murder In the Heartland

The show includes interviews with the victim's family, friends, law enforcement officers and also provides dramatic reenactments to bring the stories to life. Episodes reveal true stories such as when an Oklahoma family's dog drops a human skull onto their porch and the police are called in to investigate; a bride-to-be who discovers her betrothed shot in the head in their living room; a beloved father, son and fiancee who is discovered beaten to death in his own driveway; and a devoted family man who diappears after his truck is set on fire.

programme.desc: In November 2016, Kala Brown was found chained to a wall on Todd Kohlepp's property. After she witnessed the murder of her boyfriend, Kohlhepp kept her as his prisoner for two months. programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. Absolute Hell! Instead of heading off together into the sunset, on their luxurious romantic honeymoons to exotic locations, these poor Bride and Groom's are on their way to the Emergency Room. programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress America
programme.desc: Looking for your perfect dress? Kleinfeld Bridal is the place for you. Follow brides as they head off on their search for the perfect wedding dress, no matter how big or small in the city of New York. Bringing their friends and family along to help them decide, will they girls trip to the store be an easy one? The brides are each assisted by a consultant during a private shopping event, the outcome being that all important dress.

programme.title: The Blended Bunch
programme.desc: What started with tragedy, manifested into a once in a lifetime love story. Before meeting, Erica, a mother of 7, lost her husband to cancer and Spencer, a father of 4, lost his wife in a fatal car crash. Their worlds were completely shattered until they serendipitously met in an online widower support group. Finding love almost immediately, Erica and Spencer exchanged vows and were married after just 13 months. The series centers on their large, newly blended family that will face all kinds of challenges as they merge 11 children under one roof and adjust to a new life in Utah.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: In Thailand, elevated highways keep falling down. A fire breaks out at a bakery in a Uruguayan shopping mall, and a bridge in Colombia collapses just before construction is finished. London's skyline has become a buffet of unsightly skyscrapers, and trucks everywhere are overloaded. Without proper shoring, a building in Iowa crumbles and houses in Rodanthe keep plunging into the ocean.

programme.title: Lost Beasts: Unearthed
programme.desc: Lost Beasts Unearthed combines unique access to real-time palaeontology investigations, pioneering technology and explosive CGI animations to unlock the mysteries of the biggest beasts ever to have lived on our planet. From deadly T-Rex's to giant woolly mammoths and terrifying sabre-tooth tigers to ancient sea-monsters. New evidence reveals how these giants evolved to conquer the planet, how they grew so big, how they hunted, what they ate, how they fought and what triggered their extinction.

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley discovers how adversity has shaped this famed region and its capital, revealing a history of hardship that has resulted in creative culinary inventions. He explores the dark story behind Campania's famous tomatoes, reveals how buffalo milk went from zero to hero, and celebrates a once-forgotten wine grape. And on one of its lesser-known islands, Procida, he samples a very different take on pesto that is made with lemons.

programme.title: Defending Europe
programme.desc: Nautical archaeologist Andy Torbet explores an old sea fort, crucial to Finland's defence. Historian Mika Kulju investigates how in 1940, Finns defeated the might of the Red Army. Military historian Alex Churchill investigates two unusual weapons: a stolen Soviet tank and the Molotov Cocktail. Former soldier Arthur Williams explores Finland's extraordinary bunkers and meets Finnish reservists.

programme.title: Defending Europe
programme.desc: Battlefield archaeologist Tony Pollard explores Rochester Castle and an infamous medieval siege; Military historian Alex Churchill fires a cannon and explores how Britain responded to Napoleon's invasion threats; and former marine Arthur Williams discovers the World War II underground bunkers of a British resistance force and flies over a series of incredible sea forts.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Lost Cities Revealed with Albert Lin
programme.desc: Albert Lin is on a quest to discover an ancient lost city of the Maya - once home to the people that built the great pyramid city of Palenque. Equipped with the latest scanning technology, he must hack his way through ancient untouched jungle, swim to the bottom of a dark cenote, and abseil into the heart of a giant mountain to uncover their unbelievable origin story.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: King Solomon is one of the most famous names in the Bible—known for being wise and wealthy beyond imagination. But there is little evidence of his reign, and the age in which he lived remains a mystery. Now, archaeologists are excavating neighboring ancient kingdoms to make groundbreaking new discoveries about the long-lost world of this legendary King. Immersive CGI brings his story to life.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: The book of Revelation tells of an apocalyptic battle of good versus evil at the end of the world. It says the battle will happen in a place called Armageddon, but Armageddon is no myth. It takes its name from a real ancient settlement: Megiddo. So, what happened here to inspire a Biblical tale of such drama? Archaeologists believe that a series of battles took place here over several centuries, which may have given Megiddo a reputation for violence, turmoil and war as a series of powerful civilizations claimed it as their own. The Egyptians, Assyrians and — according to the Bible — the Israelites all flattened and then rebuilt the city. Finally, it was the site of a battle between King Josiah, the last of the line of King David, and the Egyptians, resulting in Josiah's death. Could these events be the origins of the Armageddon story?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Just minutes after taking off from Lima, the crew of Aeroperú Flight 603 is overwhelmed by a series of conflicting error messages. Flying blind through thick clouds—and unable to confirm either airspeed or altitude—the pilots don't know which alarm they can trust. A controller steps in and dispatches a rescue plane to guide them back to the airport, but help doesn't arrive in time. And just as the crew is troubleshooting over open ocean, the Boeing 757 plunges into the Pacific, instantly killing everyone on board. A Navy expedition to the sea floor proves the plane was intact when it hit the water and successfully retrieves the plane's black boxes. A single image of the wreckage reveals a minor maintenance glitch with deadly repercussions, while the flight data reveals the crew was ill-prepared for a fatal cascade of erroneous data.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route from Singapore to Perth, Qantas Airways Flight 72 takes a sudden nosedive over the Indian Ocean. Sudden G-forces are so violent passengers are lifted out of their seats. A series of over-speed and stall warnings flood the cockpit display, and it's clear something is terribly wrong. An experienced fighter pilot, the captain manages to safely land the plane. It's up to Australian investigators to uncover the mysterious and potentially deadly malfunction that's putting one of the world's most popular planes at risk.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: For millions, Jesus is both the Son of God and an actual historical figure. But what archaeological evidence exists about the people and places that shaped his life? The investigation begins at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem, said to be built upon Jesus' burial place. But there's a puzzle: In the 1st century AD, burials only took place outside the city walls, yet the church sits firmly within the Old City. Can experts solve the mystery? Elsewhere in Jerusalem, archaeologists hunt for the site where Jesus is said to have performed the miraculous healing of a Blind man — the Siloam Pool — and look for clues about the events of his final days, including the Last Supper. Beyond Jerusalem, investigators hunt for the lost town of Bethsaida, site of the feeding of five thousand and home to three of his disciples.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: In Israel, archaeologists investigate the truth behind one of the greatest discoveries in history: the Dead Sea Scrolls. Found in 1947 deep in the Judean desert, this remarkable haul of 2,000-year-old manuscripts includes the oldest copies of the biblical texts ever found. But no one knows who wrote them or why they were hidden. In this episode, investigators combine traditional excavations with revolutionary analytical technologies to uncover new evidence that could help solve these mysteries. Cutting-edge imaging techniques reveal hidden clues in the scrolls — which could help identify the authors — while archaeological discoveries in Jerusalem paint a picture of a brutal, destructive event that would tear apart the ancient Jewish world around the time the scrolls were hidden.

programme.title: Lost Cities Revealed with Albert Lin
programme.desc: In the remote deserts of Sudan Albert Lin goes in search of the lost capital city of the Kingdom of Kush, whose rulers once conquered and ruled the ancient Egyptian Empire. Armed with scanning technology never used for archaeology in Sudan before Albert's expedition takes him to a flooded tomb beneath a 2500 year old pyramid and a sacred mountain believed to be the birthplace of the gods.

programme.title: Lost Cities Revealed with Albert Lin
programme.desc: Explorer Albert Lin searches Israel for the lost city of the Canaanites, a mysterious civilisation who survived a biblical era, climate apocalypse. The expedition takes him scuba diving for 4000-year-old shipwreck treasure and through a terrifying incident on a crumbling cliff face. Using extraordinary tech, Albert reveals a spectacular maritime world, built by these ancient climate survivors.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: Archeologists excavate mountain tops, crawl underground, and experiment with early technology to reveal how ancient Roman engineering built an empire, enhanced daily life, and kept the Roman legacy on the frontline of cultural influence. From heated bathhouses and advanced plumbing systems to military supply roads and revolutionary ships, the era's groundbreaking innovations are revealed.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: Sorting relics from the rubble, archeologists race against time and the elements to recover ancient Roman artifacts. They reveal new truths about Hadrian's wall and Nero's palace, discover beautiful frescos underground, dive underwater for remarkably preserved mosaics, and carefully recover part of a warship that alters Roman naval history.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: The Roman war machine spanned all corners of the empire, from Hadrian's Wall in England to Ephesus in Turkey, from the port of Puteoli, which lies south of Rome, up north to Carnuntum in Austria. Once naval dominance of the entire Mediterranean led to the creation of the empire, Rome could shift focus to sustaining its commanding power over the vast territory. Archaeologists unearth a massive military city at a strategic location, deadly weapons from the frontlines, and bones of the victims that dared to attack the edges of the empire. Using ancient designs from the height of Rome's power, they also reconstruct a ship and catapult to test them as proof of the Romans' superior fighting power. They also uncover tombs of gladiators where the power of the imperial propaganda is on full display.

programme.desc: Hazen Audel joins the Evenki in the forests of Inner Mongolia where he learns to ride their highly prized Reindeer and protect them from bears and Lynx through the dark nights. When 2 of the herd go missing, Hazen sets off downstream in his hand made birch bark canoe then crosses deep, mosquito-infested bogs to retrieve them and return them to the herd - all the while, living off the land using traditional Evenki skills to survive.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Championship game
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Suvesangarid
programme.desc: "Suvesangarid" on lustlik suvine saade, mis tõestab, et igas Eestimaa nurgas on midagi vaatamist ja katsetamist väärt. Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Doktor Silva
programme.desc: Linna tagasi sõitma pidanud Silva tuleb Estrile ja Annikale korraks appi, et nad saaksid uuesti keskusse tööle asuda. Kuri endine perearst Heimar laiutab keskuses ja otsib juba uut ja pugejalikku kaadrit. Kogu plaan lendab aga pea peale, kui Heimar keset tulist võitlust hinge heidab. Silva elu on nüüd segasem kui eales varem, tal tuleb nüüd kriisi lõpuni keskust edasi juhtida. Samas liitub keskuse personaliga terveks hooajaks krutskeid täis koristaja Reet Pull, keda kehastab legendaarne Ita Ever.

programme.title: Pilvede all
programme.desc: Kertu ja Eriku kohtumine algab mõlema jaoks paljulubavalt. Liina on šokis ja Piret teeb talle ootamatu ettepaneku. Mari kohtub Kertuga, kuid ei kiida noorema õe plaane heaks. Inna mõõt saab täis ja Albert on sunnitud vastu võtma raske otsuse. Sirje tunneb end süüdi. Liina jagab Piretiga oma kahtlusi ning Erik teeb kõik selleks, et Kertut mõjutada.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Mark, kes on hull sarja "Kodus ja võõrsil" järele loodab kohata mõnd austraallannat, sellist nagu Bree. Süütu Kiki kohtub idealistist Lachlaniga. Kelmikas Bex läheb kohtingule energilise iirlase Anthonyga. Üksikemast Chris on valmis selleks, et leida armastust ja läheb kohtingule treener Anthonyga. Ashley unistab ehedast ja sõltumatust naisest - pildile ilmub endine merejalaväelane Nicole.

programme.title: Armastuse hind
programme.desc: Ferit on õnnelik, kui saab teada, et Nevra saab teda raha leidmisel aidata. Sanlidel on aga teine plaan. Seyran kutsub sadamase politsei Orhanit kinni võtma. Ferit on Seyranis pettunud. Ka Seyranit haavasid Feriti järjekordsed valed. Orhan on nüüd tabatud ja Ferit püüab oma isa vangist päästa. Serter helistab Pelinile üha sagedamini ja tal ei õnnestu enam teda eirata. Piril mõistab, et Pelin ei pruugi kanda Feriti last.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Majad ja saladused: Surmav leping
programme.desc: Shannon renoveerib Victoria-aegset häärberit, mis on jagatud korteriteks kehval elujärjel perekondadele. Paljud vabatahtlikud linnast tulevad talle appi. Kõik läheb libedalt, kuni kohaliku panga pahur juhataja leitakse surnuna. Tuleb välja, et pea kõigil oli põhjust pankuri surma soovida...

programme.title: Mägipäästjad
